spec.description: Leaderboard-style per-user metrics for Claude Code. Use the time picker to set the competition window.

spec.title: 🥇 Lines Added Leader
spec.description: User who added the most lines of code in the selected window.

spec.title: Cost Over Time ($/hr, 6h rolling)
spec.description: Rolling 6-hour spend rate per user in $/hr. Peaks show active coding sessions; gaps are idle time.

spec.title: Tokens vs Lines per User
spec.description: Scatter: each dot = one user. Right = more tokens; up = more lines. Top-left is most efficient.

spec.expression: SELECT CASE WHEN A.user_email = 'i@dasch.swiss' THEN 'ivan subotic' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(A.user_email, '@dasch.swiss', ''), '.', ' ') END AS user_email, A.__value__ AS tokens, B.__value__ AS loc FROM A JOIN B ON A.user_email = B.user_email LIMIT 100

spec.title: Token Efficiency per User
spec.description: Thousands of tokens used per line of code. Lower = more efficient. Users with fewer than 100 lines are excluded to avoid outliers.

spec.expr: sort(((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range])), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^@]+)@dasch.swiss"), "user_email", "ivan subotic", "user_email", "^i$"), "user_email", "$1 $2", "user_email", "([^.]+)\\.(.+)") / (1000 * clamp_min(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total[$__range])), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^@]+)@dasch.swiss"), "user_email", "ivan subotic", "user_email", "^i$"), "user_email", "$1 $2", "user_email", "([^.]+)\\.(.+)"), 1))) and on(user_email) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total[$__range])), "user_email", "$1", "user_email", "([^@]+)@dasch.swiss"), "user_email", "ivan subotic", "user_email", "^i$"), "user_email", "$1 $2", "user_email", "([^.]+)\\.(.+)") >= 100)) or label_replace(avg((sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range])) / (1000 * clamp_min(sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total[$__range])), 1))) and on(user_email) (sum by(user_email)(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total[$__range])) >= 100)), "user_email", "⌀ Average", "", ""))

spec.title: 🥇 Commits Leader
spec.description: User with the most commits in the selected window.

spec.title: 🥇 PRs Leader
spec.description: User who opened the most pull requests in the selected window.

spec.title: 🥇 Most Tokens Used
spec.description: User who consumed the most tokens — a proxy for session intensity.
